title: Velvety Roasted Peruvian Fish Ceviche
description: A comforting Peruvian dish featuring roasted fish, brandy, and a brine-dry method, perfect for pescatarians. This recipe combines the flavors of the sea with the warmth of roasted ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the halibut fillets with salt and coriander.
Roast the halibut in the oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine brandy, lime juice, garlic, and ginger in a blender.
Blend the mixture until smooth, then strain it into a bowl.
Add the roasted halibut to the bowl and marinate for 10 minutes.
Dice the red onion and aji amarillo peppers, then add them to the bowl.
Mix all the ingredients together, then serve immediately.
Garnish with additional coriander and lime juice, if desired.
